result.title: TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile
result.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/TIMBRE ; Checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/TIMBRE
result.summary: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

AI.brief_summary: TIMBRE 面向事件驱动的时序预测，在冻结的预测头前组合来源感知表示、状态条件下的响应迁移与可靠性引导融合，并通过单独读出调整区间宽度，同时保留中位数。单种子、一 epoch 的 13 任务开发性研究显示其仅在两个任务上优于原生 Chronos-2，且对响应迁移机制的敏感性明显。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与 LVR 的共同线索是「外部证据/历史状态如何写入内部数值状态」，其可靠性引导融合与区间读出可供核查多源视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新及停止决策的借鉴；但任务是时序预测而非多模态推理，联系较远。
